justification.text: 2 ≤ r is the problem's range 'for all t, r ≥ 2' (inclusive); the informal text says the restriction r ≥ 2 excludes forbidding a single edge, so r = 2 is deliberately the first case.
2 ≤ t is the problem's range 'for all t, r ≥ 2' (inclusive) stated in the informal text; t is the uniformity of the hypergraph.

theorem Opn.erdos_1158 :
    ∀ t r : ℕ, 2 ≤ t → 2 ≤ r →
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      (n : ℝ) ^ ((t : ℝ) - (r : ℝ) ^ (1 - (t : ℝ)) - ε) ≤
        (Hypergraph.partiteExtremalNumber n t r : ℝ) := by
  sorry
